helper_reuse: levanter.main.model_init.prepare_model_init_context: native source HF architecture inference and option propagation before validation; named source converter binding
levanter.main.model_init.load_model_from_source: existing common source routes; cast_to_param argument receives existing mp.cast_to_compute for inference
levanter.model_loading.load_hf_checkpoint via load_model_from_source: native FP32 master load, full source vocabulary and HF architecture/layout validation
levanter.model_loading.load_levanter_checkpoint via load_model_from_source: source metadata identity validation, full native source vocabulary and explicit target mesh restore
TrainerConfig.use_device_mesh plus requires_explicit_mesh_axes existing viz caller pattern
Existing InferenceEngine.from_model_with_config, cache lifecycle, Requests and GenerationResult; unchanged per-round output loop
Existing write_llama_checkpoint, tiny_hf_tokenizer_path fixture, save_checkpoint and native checkpoint_metadata for real local assets
evidence_limits: CPU source/code qualification only. CPU ragged_paged_attention dispatch uses existing default reference. No accelerator kernel execution, substitution or performance claim.
BF16 parameter conversion/full source weight identity is checked; BF16 engine check is existing greedy-only coverage. Full-forward BF16 numerical parity is not claimed.
Named checkpoint keeps existing tokenizer-sized template contract; native metadata preserves stored rows beyond tokenizer.
Levanter fixture is real native model-subtree restore, not optimizer/full-state migration or partial DPO/LoRA restore evidence.
Full repository affected suite and independent CPU8 qualification not performed by author; independent maintained review remains pending with root.
No accelerator, remote object storage, network source lookups, secret reads, CI, PR, automation, commit or push actions.

controls.source_scope: Only sample_lm source differs between caller runs; shared loaders/model/engine remain inherited identical source. Each run builds real tiny local HF source and native model-subtree checkpoints from same seeded named source parameters.

marker_boundary: Initial and R1 author commands use package defaults notslow/nottorch, no marker override; not root-default qualification.
_archive_note: Historical phase/source/status retained. Embedded artifact hashes identify original inputs, not sanitized copies; output hashes/lengths and exact transformations are in manifest. No numerical execution during archiving. Paths are normalized; an old review that reused a later patch filename remains qualified by its own historical patch digest.
